content.text:
Here are some **current Domino’s voucher / promo codes** worth trying in the **U.S.**:

- **P50** — reported as **50% off pizza in the Domino’s app**. ([picodi.com](https://www.picodi.com/us/dominos?utm_source=openai))  
- **50off** — reported as **50% off any purchase / pizza offer**. ([groupon.com](https://www.groupon.com/coupons/dominos?utm_source=openai))  
- **9413** — reported as **50% off menu-priced pizzas**. ([groupon.com](https://www.groupon.com/coupons/dominos?utm_source=openai))  
- **9213** — reported for a **bundle deal**: 2 medium 1-topping pizzas + bread bites + cinnamon twists + 2-liter drink. ([groupon.com](https://www.groupon.com/coupons/dominos?utm_source=openai))  
- **1126** — reported as **20% off**. ([goodshop.com](https://www.goodshop.com/coupons/dominos.com?utm_source=openai))  
- **9214** — reported as **20% off menu-priced orders**. ([goodshop.com](https://www.goodshop.com/coupons/dominos.com?utm_source=openai))  
- **1253** — reported as **10% off select items**. ([simplycodes.com](https://simplycodes.com/store/dominos.com?utm_source=openai))  

Also check Domino’s **official coupons page** in the app/site, since many offers are store-specific. Current official offers include local coupons, the **Mix & Match** deal, and carryout deals; availability and pricing vary by location. ([dominos.com](https://www.dominos.com/es/pages/order/coupon?utm_source=openai))

Tip: try the code at checkout after selecting your local store—some franchise locations disable certain coupons.
